transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got the final-delivery meeting for After the Floodlights coming up Thursday morning, and the platform submission window closes Friday at 5:00 PM. Let's make sure we're all prepared. I need the post-production supervisor and clearance producer to each be ready to state their confirmed specifications aloud, record their respective documentation commitments, and then I'll close out the package. I don't want us opening any unrelated follow-up work at that point — we need to keep this clean and get it submitted on time.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before Thursday's meeting. After the current draft package circulated, I checked the platform's delivery portal and confirmed that this title must be delivered as an exactly 48-minute master with stereo audio and both English and Spanish subtitle files. The portal response is still in my production inbox awaiting the final-delivery meeting. This conflicts with the current draft, which lists a 52-minute master, 5.1 audio, and English subtitles only.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical on the clearance side before Thursday. After the current draft package circulated, I confirmed with the documentary's licensing administrator that the release is permitted only in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom — not worldwide as the current draft states. Additionally, any promotional clip may be no longer than exactly 30 seconds, which conflicts with the 90-second promotional clip listed in the current draft. I have not yet entered this confirmation in the rights log, so I need to make sure that gets documented as part of my clearance commitments.
transcript.speaker: A3
